steps.content: People in various shelters are trembling in fear. Just now, Julien's announcement got cut off and the screen blacked out. Somebody barged into his office.

steps.speaker: Panicking Crowd
steps.content: Why did the announcement stop?

steps.speaker: Panicking Crowd
steps.content: Was there an accident? Did Julien get attacked?! Then what about us...

steps.speaker: Noise In The Crowd
steps.content: He fled... with that spy... He abandoned the Drifter Camp, leaving us to die...

steps.speaker: Panicking Crowd
steps.content: No, he said Rustfire would fight to protect us. He'd been operating the mechanisms to protect us until just now!

steps.speaker: Noise In The Crowd
steps.content: Where are they now?? Contamination has broken out. We're all going to die. Haha, pawns... We're all just disposable pawns!
Bzzzz...
A sharp buzz pierces through the air. The screen is turned on again, but it's not showing Julien's face.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: To those who choose to stay, this is ${PlayerName} from the Minos Bureau of Crisis Control. As requested by your leader Julien, I'm here to protect the Drifter Camp.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: We've already worked together to stop the Executive Committee's violent invasion. Now, we must stop the Mania contamination from escalating.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Before all of you are safely evacuated, we won't go anywhere.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...It's him?

steps.speaker: Noise In The Crowd
steps.content: The DisCity's authorities sent him to sabotage the Drifter Camp! Liar! It's a plot!
steps.female_content: The DisCity's authorities sent her to sabotage the Drifter Camp! Liar! It's a plot!

steps.speaker: Noise In The Crowd
steps.content: The one who killed Zoya!

steps.speaker: Nervous Inhabitant
steps.content: It's true... He's our enemy...

steps.speaker: Noise In The Crowd
steps.content: He's in the operation station. We'll go and kill him!
steps.female_content: She's in the operation station. We'll go and kill her!

steps.content: A middle-aged man on the edge of a nervous breakdown gets up slowly and takes out his knife. Just when he wants to step forward, Taran pulls him back and puts him on the ground.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Stop!

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: What's that idiot thinking? Revealing his identity now will get him killed!
steps.female_content: What's that idiot thinking? Revealing her identity now will get her killed!

steps.speaker: Noise In The Crowd
steps.content: It's Rustfire. Rustfire betrayed us too! This is all a scheme. Soon, they'll...

steps.speaker: (Scene change)
steps.content: (Scene change)

Through the glass of the broadcasting station, you peer down at the commotion of the crowd. Though you can't hear them clearly, the angry swings of punches and incessant stones flying this way are clear enough proof of their attitude toward you.
No, it'll be pointless. People have already lost their judgment. Not to mention that under Mania's influence, their minds are extremely weak now.

In times like this, those who can seize the crowd's weakness will win. Parma did that. They caught the despair and fear sharply, exaggerated the situation, and incited panic. You've seen their way. It's a skill beyond your reach.
...Go and look for another weak spot. Human hearts are fragile and often have more than one weakness.
Bang bang bang!

Several bullets hit the glass in front of you, leaving radial cracks with the impact. You can't see clearly what's happening outside anymore. You're uncertain if the shooter did it out of fear or hatred, or if they're in fact one of Parma's spies.
But it doesn't matter who they are. You stop K.K. from rushing over, and look at the camera.
Confess your most sincere emotions to that tiny black hole.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Just now, someone tried to shoot me...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Bravo! You remain vigilant. You refuse to run away. You never give in. You're all regular civilians, yet you have such strong resolve to fight. All of you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Keep your fighting spirit, because the real enemy will soon emerge. The battle is about to begin.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Hang in there. I'll fight alongside you. Never give up.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: ...You think you can win them over with this cliché? No one's gonna buy it, you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Hang in there. Zoya is on her way!
This time, even muted by the bulletproof glass, you can still hear the clamor outside.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why are you surprised? That's Zoya, the Legion's leader, Syndicate's game-breaker, the strongest warrior. How could she die in a place like that, in the hands of some despicable scoundrels?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Listen, I came not just to forge an alliance with Julien. I'm an ally of the Legion. I came to seek vengeance, and to realize the Legion's belief.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The Drifter Camp has suffered the worst disaster. There are people who hate you so much that they can't stand your existence. They'll do anything to banish each one of you and obliterate your home, even if it means using Mania, the most fearsome power.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The same people ambushed the entire Legion using the same trick in Keylan Square six months ago.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Zoya crushed their scheme, but at a heavy cost. Despite that, the Legion's belief has never changed. She wants me to say this to everyone in the Drifter Camp:

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: "Fighting is meaningful, and so is resisting. I'll never give up Syndicate. I'll never be defeated by this!"

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's right... I came on behalf of Zoya, to fight with you!

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: You're lying.
He sees through your lie right away. He lowers his voice so the microphone won't pick it up, but he doesn't hide his doubt.

steps.speaker: Options
options: Don't expose me. Isn't it easier to just believe me?

steps.content: He stares straight at you, ignoring your terrible joke.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Zoya didn't die, but she won't be here. You think it's only a matter of time before this lie gets exposed, but the truth is, I don't need to gain anyone's trust.
The commotion outside grows louder. Shock, suspicion, confusion, and a wary hope... Exactly what you wish for.
Whether they believe or doubt it, desire or hate it, it doesn't matter. As long as they give it their attention, that's enough.
Like cowardice, the desire for a great leader is also a weakness in everyone's heart. You'll give them an ideal leader. Take advantage of this glimmer of hope.

<size=32>Stop imagining unknown fear. Stop worrying about imaginary hostility. If the hatching of a Corpus requires extreme, highly concentrated spiritual energy, then just take away everyone's attention and imagination. You're so sick of it devouring everyone's mind!</size>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The shackles have touched your half-body. I know you're around.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A dark, weak, and despicable monster who wants to prey on everyone using all kinds of wicked tricks.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Quit hiding. Now that you've brought this big mess, they're already searching for your other half. All of us will hunt you down and kill you. How much time do you think you have left?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: The one who "killed" you eight years ago should be knocking on your door soon too, don't you think?
Crack!
(Transition)
An enormous hand crushes the screen, crushes your face. In a daze, you see the gigantic, inhuman creature perches on top of those screens. It turns its gaze onto you.

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: What are you... prying into...

steps.speaker: Corpus
steps.content: Give me back... my power!!
It lunges up suddenly and vanishes before your eyes again, but that strong power surges toward you.

steps.speaker: Julien
steps.content: Mmph...!
The impact throws Julien onto the wall, off the wheelchair. K.K. catches him in time. She calls out to you.

steps.speaker: K.K.
steps.content: Go! I'll look after him. Just go and fight. You have to win!
You release the shackles. They fill up the space, touching the spilled contamination like a net in an attempt to capture that monster.
Even now, you can't see its true form. But that hysterical, twisted, chaotic presence reeking of death is right before you!
